newsitem.title: USA: James River sees Q4 $0.15 EPS gain.
newsitem.headline: James River sees Q4 $0.15 EPS gain.

text.p: James River Corp said it expects to report a fourth-quarter gain of about $0.15 a share from the sale of its 45 percent interest in WinCup Holdings LP to Radnor Holdings Corp, which it completed today.
The company received the stake in January 1996, when it combined its Handi-Kup foam operations with Radnor's foam cup operations to form WinCup, it said.

The company said it has amassed about $496 million in gross proceeds from asset sales this year. That's in-line with the company's plan to raise $500 million in cash from diversitures this year to pay down debt, it said.
